strings.en: Brother...? Are you looking at that asteroid?
The more I look at it, the more hopeless it seems.
Hey! We're about to go in, so don't say such ominous stuff!
Even so, it's the truth.
Jet! Drill! ...Geez, Brother, quit staying quiet and say something.
Master Rom... what is it?
...I can't see their aim.
Their aim? Crushing Earth, right!?
If that thing hits, it'll be way worse than any colony drop!
...But doing that would wreck the asteroid too... That's what puzzles me.
Oh, I get it. It's not like Zeon dropping something and moving on...
if it hits, then their side's done for too...
So I was considering the exception...
If they don't mean to go down with Earth, there's only one option...
Exception...? Rom, what is it...
...I thought the idea absurd... but they likely intend to land.
L-Land!?
But, but, it's as big as the moon! They'll get squished like dumplings!
Truly absurd.
Hey now, Rom, that's a bit much...
Right, people will say, "What are the Cronosians thinking?"
...Actually, it's been bugging me too.
What, Roux?
A planet that size... if something like that
got between Earth and the moon, the gravity would devastate Earth!
Indeed... There seems to be radio interference,
but normally it wouldn't stop at just that.
I don't get the hard stuff... but I remember reading about it in sci-fi...
Um, something's limit or whatever?
What, what? Hard stuff!?
The Roche limit. ...Indeed.
If that isn't happening... then that asteroid can approach
without causing that problem... Troublesome.
Like hell I'll let them do that...! Leina's on Earth...!
Oh, right! Speaking of which, how's Leina doing, Judau?
Who's this Leina?
Judau's little sister, the apple of his eye.
I haven't been able to reach her since the war started...
Dammit, now I'm suddenly worried...
and we're about to go in...!
It'll be okay, Judau. We just have to stop that thing!
You've got to do your best, for your sister too.
Yeah. ...Leina, please be safe...!
So you've finally come this far, Earthlings.
...And at a time like this, he's...
Keim.
L-Lady Diore!
My apologies, I was lost in thought.
It's fine. Keim... it seems you've grown too attached to Shapiro.
Ah, no, I...
But why is Lord Shapiro so fixated on mere Earthlings...
...It is his blood.
His blood...?
Shapiro's blood calls him to Earth, his mother planet...
Just as the Dirad, our world...
never once forgot that it lay in Earth's orbit 200 million years ago...
What!? The Dirad... was once at that planet...!?
Not even Abel knows this... The rooting we failed to achieve then...
now is the time for it.
Lady Diore, please give me one more chance to defeat the Earthlings.
There is no need for you to leave the Dirad.
But then they'll invade the sacred Dirad!
Any who try to invade will be eliminated by them...
You will stand by inside, in case something happens.
Them? The ones who appeared recently, the ones called the Einst?
They too wish for the Dirad to take root.
They will lend us their strength...
You summoned me, Lady Diore...
You've come, Abel.
The Earthlings are attempting to invade the Dirad.
...I know. The Dirad will not stop...
Dispose of the Earthlings before it takes root.
I shall finish them without fail.
(200 million years ago... when Lady Diore went to sleep...
why wasn't the rooting achieved then...?)
This is... Emperor... the robot you spoke of?
Yes. This is the Za Boom Army's final trump card... Zerokage.
That form, that name... Is it related to Tobikage?
Yes. ...With this, we can fight that Tobikage as equals.
...But until now, no one has been found who can freely control it.
Then it's like those three machines Joe Maya and the others pilot...
Indeed... But it seems the time has finally come to put Zerokage to work.
Someone who can move this robot!? Who could...
...When Ilbora first came here... Zerokage showed a faint reaction.
Ilbora...!? Then Ilbora is Zerokage's...?
Well, just watch. Fuhahaha...
First colonies, now a whole planet. ...But the scale is just too great.
Honestly... I don't think our going in will change anything...
And there's still so much we need to do...
Why're you two getting cold feet all of a sudden?
We've been out of options but charging in loads of times before!
Koji, this time we're up against a planet. It won't be that easy...
Losing your nerve, Captain?
Charging in and forcing a way through is what we've always done.
But Tetsuya, it's a planet this time. It won't be that easy...
Geez, all you ever think about is charging in head-on!
...But no getting cold feet, Captain Bright, okay?
That's right.
No getting cold feet! If we don't stop that plant planet,
retaking Mars will be out of the question!
Yurika...
Besides, with the colony laser unable to fire, there's no option but this.
...It seems we must steel ourselves, Captain.
Easy for you to say. Since when were you such an optimist, Captain?
...Do I seem like one?
Hey, you've got us! It'll be fine!
Where does that confidence come from, I wonder... Honestly.
So, what do you plan to do, Captain?
We have no choice but to destroy it from within,
but the problem is that every option lacks certainty...
Can't the Nadesico's Phase Transition Cannon do something?
The area the Phase Transition Cannon can affect is limited.
It won't conveniently take out a whole plant planet.
If we go inside and destroy the core, that should do it.
It started as a cluster of small rocks, after all.
Maybe the bonds will come undone and it'll fall apart...
I wonder...
In an atmosphere, the phase transition engines lose output...
so whether we can muster enough power to destroy the core...
Not so easy, huh...
Let's give it a try!
It'll be fine. Worst case, I'll overload the Nadesico's engines.
Overload all four of the Nadesico's engines, and kaboom goes the planet.
Yep, that'll do it!
Overload...? You mean to self-destruct?
Ahem, speaking for Nergal, I can't exactly recommend it...
But given the circumstances...
weighing the loss of the Nadesico against the loss of Earth...
Ah, um, if possible... I'd like the Nadesico to come through safely too.
We're sacrificing the Nadesico...
Are you really okay with this, Akatsuki?
Well, can't be helped, can it?
If Earth gets swallowed by that thing, I'll have all sorts of problems.
Overloading phase transition engines... What an outrageous idea.
That plan seems the most certain, Captain Misumaru.
Yes, let's go with a two-stage plan.
...Though sacrificing my own ship hardly makes me a good captain.
Yurika...
In any case, the center of that plant planet... that's where we strike.
The problem is how to find that center...
What will you do, Captain?
Everyone will enter the plant planet aboard the Nadesico.
We're not going on the Ra Cailum?
As Dr. Inez said earlier, this planet has an atmosphere...
Its environment apparently isn't much different from Earth's. That means...
Ra Cailum-class ships are space battleships...
so they can't descend directly to the surface.
Even if you say the core... can we tell where it is?
Back when the asteroid was a small rock, as Umon said...
the energy readings observed there remain on record...
So all we can do is follow that. Quite a primitive approach.
But it's all we can bet on, right?
Once inside the planet, split up and take them out one by one.
Do we really need to split up?
Yes. If the enemy concentrates in one spot, the Nadesico
won't be able to reach the core... We can't take too long.
So the Nadesico can head straight for the core,
we just have to raise hell, huh?
While we rampage around it, the Nadesico heads for the core, then.
Correct. The Nadesico reaching the core is top priority.
That about settles it...
Once we're inside, I'll leave command to Captain Misumaru...
Whatever it takes, guide the Nadesico to the core.
Leave it to me!
A captain who lost her ship... That's kinda cool, don't you think!?
Geez, even at a time like this, you...
Well, without that kind of composure, I don't think
we'd get through the situation we're in. That's my take.
Composure, huh? Had we joined the Gandor, we might have some...
Space... huh.
What's wrong, Captain Amuro?
It's our first time in space... but if anything,
isn't this more your home turf?
...Space doesn't let people's wills escape... That's what scares me.
Can't say I follow. Or why you call space "the sky," either.
People's wills... Amuro, are you still...
(Are you all right with it... Char?)
Man, this is boring.
If we could just warp like the Elshank,
we'd be at that plant planet in no time.
The Gandor's pushing itself as it is, Mister.
If it gets there in time, I don't care if it catches fire a bit... Hm?
Ngh... What's this... my head...
Something wrong?
(Come... this way... Excellen...)
(Excellen...!?)
(I need you, you see...)
Kyosuke, are you all right?
...Y-Yeah.
Pull yourself together. We've got a big job ahead.
(...What was that...? Could something have happened to Excellen...)
Hm? The little one's... acting weird too?
There you are! Cham, what's wrong? Cham!
This happened before too... Hey, Cham! And... Kyosuke too!?
S-Someone's calling...
What's wrong? Are you okay?
Uuugh, Show, Marvel...
You two as well!?
What, what is this feeling?
A-An awful feeling...
...Ngh... Is it them...? If so... this is bad... Excellen...!
Ugh, Weiss! Why are you like this!?
Hm? What's up? Excellen's throwing a tantrum.
All women are hysterical to some degree, though.
Heh, ain't that the truth.
But Excellen sure likes doing maintenance.
She wasn't like that before.
It's just lately. She's like that after every battle.
There was that time she sortied on her own, remember?
Maybe it started around then...
Oh yeah, that happened.
Hey, Kappei, Uchuta! You're not done with the Zambot either!
Come on, we're swapping the data, so get back to your cockpits!
Come on, you lot too! Shinobu, Ryo, Masato! And Ryo!
Don't go spouting nonsense about all women being hysterical!
Whoa, scary.
What...?
What's wrong, Excellen?
N-Nothing at all!
Come to me...
Excellen...
Hey, you okay? Get a grip... Excellen.
...I have to go to...
Huh? What're you talking about?
Excellen! What's wrong!? We haven't sortied yet...!
Huh? Ah! Hey, what are you doing!? There's no sortie order yet...
What the?
Hm? ...A sortie? Enemy attack!?
Bridge! Captain! The Weissritter's on the catapult!
What!?
Excellen!
Open a channel! Excellen! No sortie order's been given!
What do you think you're doing!
No good, she's not responding! Excellen! Come back!
Who just launched?
Ngh...! Again... and at a time like this, of all times!
Excellen... what on earth is happening...!?
...Understood?
Emperor... what does this mean?
...Why return to planet Za Boom now?
My purpose in coming to Earth... confirming the ninja legend, is done.
...Next, I must fully conquer the Schema system and secure my hold.
...Then what do you intend to do about conquering the solar system?
I leave it to you two. I believe you have the ability.
Join forces, the two of you, and as soon as possible,
bring me word that you rule the solar system.
But...
Worry not... I will follow your lead.
What?
...I said I yield all command to you, Charm.
Well then, see that you two manage it. Fuhahaha...
Sire.
...As you wish.
(Heh... So Ilbora won't show his true colors before me... Very well.
I'll take a look at things on my way back.)
We've left Earth's gravity... It won't be long now.
Heh, from out here it's a tiny planet. In a universe this vast...
I don't get why Earth's the only one getting targeted.
Seeing it again, it's really beautiful.
Somehow... even though I wasn't born here, it feels so nostalgic...
Huh...? Lenny, you're not from Earth?
I was born on Mars. ...Would that make me a Martian?
Really? I was sure you were from the same planet
as that princess who's always in a tizzy.
A Martian... like an octopus thing?
That's an old-fashioned image, Tetsuya.
Nah, Martians are octopus things, so Lenny can't be one.
Your image is pretty old-fashioned too, Koji.
If you go there, these days, Spacenoids...
people born in space might outnumber the rest.
I'm one too, Shiro. If we'd both been born on Earth...
we might have met sooner...
Aina...
Ahh, yes, yes, spare us. That's not for the bridge.
It doesn't matter anymore who's from what planet.
I thought aliens would look way scarier.
They're no different from us.
Well, the Dangaioh team looks scary in more ways than one.
Huh? What's that supposed to mean?
...Let's not go there.
Hmm... Perhaps there's something like common roots.
Roots?
Yes, a common ancestor.
For Earthlings and aliens to be this close... no, nearly the same...
their roots must be the same, or very closely related.
So Earth is...?
No, that we don't know, Alice.
Perhaps Earthlings came later.
There are countless planets in the universe, after all.
Sounds like he's back to being Dr. Hazuki, the bio-hi-tech authority.
I can't believe he's the doctor who built Dancougar.
What kind of principle runs on wild instinct?
How logical. Just like the Commander. He'd get along with Father.
...And yet Dancougar runs on wild power. How's that logical?
Ahem... We'll soon enter the combat zone.
All pilots, stand by at your stations!
(Now it's whether the dragon's life holds out... I'm counting on you.)
Do we know where Excellen went?
Only that she headed toward the Dark Zone.
It was a place where there was nothing.
Nothing? That's hardly unusual in space.
I'll explain. It's where the asteroid belt should have been.
But there's nothing, as if everything vanished...
and communications malfunctioned as well.
Which is why finding Hibiki and the others took so long.
And that's... where the Einst appear out of nowhere.
It was a creepy place... You wouldn't want to stay long.
Seriously. But what's it got to do with Excellen?
Still, I didn't want to stay there long.
...Other places don't bother me at all.
Seriously. But what's it got to do with Excellen?
Hard to say. But one thing's certain... that mysterious enemy.
Hibiki, you and her... and besides you two, Kyosuke too, I believe...
Yes. Not as much as Excellen,
but he did seem a little off whenever that enemy showed up.
Come to think of it, he's been kinda weird lately, I tell ya.
...Could it be...
Got something in mind, Rom?
No... I recall Diondra could use illusions that control minds... but...
It's happened to me, Rom.
I was looking into her eyes... and suddenly I couldn't think for myself...
It only works if she sees you directly, right, Brother?
It's not as if an enemy got aboard, after all.
Right. On the deck, Excellen looked like something had possessed her,
but... that was her own will.
That makes even less sense.
...It may seem cold, but Excellen will have to wait.
What!? Captain Bright!?
Isn't that a bit much?
We have a job to do... We've no time, and no one to spare for a search.
That's right. It's the fault of whoever goes off on their own.
Odd coming from you, Fujiwara... but I guess it can't be helped...
Given the situation... Geez, that lady's got lousy timing.
Of all times, it had to be now...
Captain!
Has something happened, Lieutenant Emma!?
The asteroid's speed is... dropping!
What!? Then maybe we can avoid the collision!?
...No... It just buys us a little time.
It might even... be bait.
Bait, huh... Sounds fun! I'll take on as many as they've got!
Bait, huh... Interesting...!
...What's this...? And the radio jamming... seems slightly weaker.
Then we can contact the Gandor!?
Not yet... but it's possible.
All right, even if it's bait... we have no choice...!
All hands, prepare to sortie!
(Are you coming... Sara? Not once, but twice... against me...)
Lord Shapiro...! So this is where you were?
The humans will soon land on our Dirad.
Please go further inside.
Never mind that.
...The woman called Sara... seems to weigh on your mind, Lord Shapiro...
Sara is... the woman you loved when you were on that planet, Earth...
And for you, who chases endless ambition, the one thing...
that makes you care about something as small as Earth...
...How do you know that?
...So I have heard from Lady Diore.
...Keim! You overstep...!
L-Lord Shapiro...!?
I... will not forgive anyone who tries to peer inside me...!
L-Lord Shapiro... I... I can't bear it,
Lord Shapiro, I... I don't want to lose you...
(So this is... Zerokage... I see, its basic structure does resemble Tobikage's...
If only I could move it...)
Ilbora.
...Charm.
Heh... You can't dawdle forever anymore either.
...Your impatience shows in your walk.
Hmph, nobody likes a pushy woman... Think up a strategy instead.
With the Emperor back in the Schema system, I gave you command,
but not so you could take it easy.
Heheheh... No need to worry about me.
More importantly, the Gandor... headed for that plant planet.
Shouldn't you go after it?
That plant planet... It may be the perfect chance to get behind them.
I hear Zerokage won't move... What a shame.
Hmph, an enhanced Skeleton will do.
Do try to earn some glory.
(Glory... I've no interest in that... For now, Joe...)
Commander Hazuki, we're nearly at PLS Black Point!
Communications!?
Still down... but the jamming's weakening. With luck...
If Bright and the others survived... we might be able to reach them.
Don't say that, Amuro!
It's fine. Bright and the others are surely doing well.
Ngh...
Kyosuke!? What's wrong? I'd heard you weren't feeling well...
Commander... hurry... we have to get to... that one...!
"That one"...? Who do you mean?
Who?
(It may already be too late...)
Commander Hazuki! We've reached the Ra Cailum!
Captain Bright!
So you've come up to space, Commander Hazuki.
We succeeded in retaking Jaburo. ...The colony laser...
seems to have been a failure.
Yes. Shapiro Keats got the better of us.
Shapiro Keats...!? Surely not... Major Shapiro!? Impossible...
It's the truth.
...In any case, we're carrying out an operation to destroy the plant planet.
...An operation to destroy it?
The Nadesico will go in and destroy the core,
triggering the collapse of the entire planet...
Inside, our units will draw off the enemy to aid the Nadesico.
Destroy the planet's core? Then what of the Nadesico and the units?
...After defeating the enemy forces, each will attempt to escape.
The Ra Cailum... to recover any units that make it out,
has no choice but to wait in orbit above the plant planet...
But doesn't that make the odds of survival far too low!?
I wish there were a surer way... but there's no time.
We judged this method has the best chance of destroying it.
...There is still another way. ...One that won't sacrifice the Nadesico,
and can likely destroy the planet's core...!
Commander Hazuki...?
In any case, we of the Gandor Team will follow the Nadesico.
...Where Captain Quattro's unit is deployed
is the entry point, correct?
Yes. ...The fighting is far from over. Be sure to come back...
I'll do everything I can.
It would ease my mind a bit if you'd just say "understood."
Scientists, you see, never use the words "without fail"
until the very, very end, Captain Bright.
